proposals.subtype: Explicit optional API-version argument forwarded only when non-None
proposals.explanation: The exported synchronous client subclass declares a keyword-only api_version defaulting to None. Its constructor inserts that value into kwargs only when non-None, then delegates endpoint, credential and kwargs to the generated base constructor. It does not itself choose or validate a service-version default.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The nonempty root _patch.py exports ConversationAnalysisClient and implements this concrete constructor on a generated-client subclass.

proposals.subtype: Expose URL-derived operation ID and cached final-state details
proposals.explanation: AnalyzeConversationLROPoller.details reads Operation-Location from the polling method's private initial response with an AttributeError/TypeError fallback. Its helper parses the URL path, strips trailing slashes and takes the last segment only when the remaining path contains a slash. The getter includes job status/identity, display name, timestamps, statistics, errors and next link when _record_state_for_details has populated the initially empty cache.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: An exported custom LROPoller subclass implements the metadata getter, parser and cache setter in the root patch rather than simply exporting the base poller.

proposals.subtype: Continuation factory reconstructs the custom synchronous poller
proposals.explanation: AnalyzeConversationLROPoller.from_continuation_token delegates token decoding to the supplied polling method, obtains client/initial response/deserialization callback and returns cls instantiated with that tuple and polling method. No cached final state is explicitly restored here.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The exported patch poller class provides a concrete override of the continuation-token classmethod.

proposals.subtype: Conversation-job wrapper returns pages of action containers and records details
proposals.explanation: begin_analyze_conversation_job configures an API-version decorator, normalizes request options and chooses LROBasePolling, NoPolling or a supplied method. A truthy token is passed to the custom poller's factory; otherwise the method calls the private initial operation and constructs/registers the custom poller. Its HTTP-200-only callback decodes operation state, indexes the poller holder to record it and returns ItemPaged or calls cls with that pager. The pager starts from the decoded state, follows next_link with GETs requiring 200 and yields [state.actions] per page, not flattened actions.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The exported patch client implements the activation, custom result callback, pager and poller wiring around a private generated operation.

proposals.subtype: Async client explicitly forwards a supplied API version
proposals.explanation: The asynchronous client subclass declares keyword-only api_version=None and adds it to kwargs only when non-None before delegating endpoint, credential and kwargs to its generated base. Its own body does not assign a version when the argument is omitted.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The aio patch exports this concrete generated-client subclass and implements its constructor.

proposals.subtype: Async poller exposes operation identity and cached final-state metadata
proposals.explanation: AnalyzeConversationAsyncLROPoller.details obtains an Operation-Location value from the polling method's private initial response, with a missing-attribute/type fallback, and parses the final nonempty slash-delimited URL path segment when the stripped path contains a slash. It augments operation_id with job status/identity, display name, timestamps, statistics, errors and next link when its explicit state cache has been populated.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The exported custom AsyncLROPoller subclass in aio/_patch.py contains a real details property, parser and state-recording method.

proposals.subtype: Continuation factory reconstructs the custom async poller type
proposals.explanation: AnalyzeConversationAsyncLROPoller.from_continuation_token obtains the client, initial response and deserialization callback from the polling method's token factory, then constructs cls with these and the polling method. The classmethod is not itself async and does not explicitly restore cached job metadata.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The exported async patch poller overrides the continuation-token factory with this concrete reconstruction body.

proposals.subtype: Async job poller shapes completion into pages of action containers
proposals.explanation: The async begin_analyze_conversation_job configures an API-version decorator, chooses AsyncLROBasePolling, AsyncNoPolling or a supplied method and resumes a truthy token via the custom poller factory. Otherwise it awaits the private initial operation, buffers the initial response and constructs/registers the custom async poller. Its HTTP-200-only callback records decoded state through the holder and returns AsyncItemPaged or invokes cls with it. Paging uses one actions container per state and fetches next_link through GETs that require 200 and buffer the response.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The exported aio patch client has concrete activation, custom poller/callback and asynchronous paging implementations around a generated initial operation.

decisions.reason: The exported patch subclass implements a keyword-only option and forwards it only when supplied; the cited code does not establish any service-version default or validation.

The handwritten getter also exposes cached final-state fields, so the operation-ID-only pattern understates the reusable behavior. The source establishes a conditional metadata view, not that it is always populated.

finding.subtype: Expose operation ID and available operation-state metadata
finding.explanation: The custom poller's details getter parses the Operation-Location header from its polling method's initial response into an operation ID and conditionally adds status, job identity, timestamps, statistics, errors and next link from the state cached by _record_state_for_details.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The root _patch.py exports this custom poller and implements the URL parser, state setter and metadata getter rather than merely re-exporting a generated type.

decisions.reason: The exported handwritten poller supplies a concrete factory that reconstructs its own class from the polling method's continuation tuple; it does not show restoration of cached metadata.

The proposal combines two distinct handwritten behaviors under the begin method: custom LRO activation/result callback and a next-link pager implemented in separate nested helpers. Retain the LRO behavior under this identity and report the helper-owned pager as an inconclusive omission.

finding.subtype: Wrap generated job submission with custom polling and result shaping
finding.explanation: The patched client method selects a polling method or resumes from a truthy token; otherwise it calls the private initial operation and constructs a custom poller whose HTTP-200-only result callback decodes operation state, records it for details and passes a pager to an optional cls callback or returns the pager.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The root _patch.py exports the client subclass with a concrete begin method that builds a poller and result callback around its generated private initial operation.

decisions.reason: The aio patch exports a client subclass whose constructor forwards an explicitly supplied API-version option to its generated base without setting an omitted value.

The async getter exposes conditional cached operation-state details in addition to the operation ID, which calls for a broader reusable pattern name; there is no evidence the state is always available.

finding.subtype: Expose operation ID and available async operation-state metadata
finding.explanation: The custom async poller's details getter parses an Operation-Location value from the polling method's initial response into an operation ID and conditionally adds status, job identity, timestamps, statistics, errors and next link from the state cached by _record_state_for_details.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The aio/_patch.py exports the custom async poller with a concrete URL parser, state setter and details property, rather than a generated-poller re-export.

decisions.reason: The exported custom async poller implements a synchronous classmethod that reconstructs cls from the token factory's returned tuple; the source does not show restoration of cached state.

The proposal folds next-link paging helpers into the LRO instance. The async pager is a distinct handwritten behavior implemented by nested helpers; retain the begin method's custom polling/result callback here and list the pager as an inconclusive omission.

finding.subtype: Wrap async job submission with custom polling and result shaping
finding.explanation: The patched async client method selects an async polling method or resumes from a truthy token; otherwise it awaits the private initial operation, buffers the initial response and constructs a custom async poller whose HTTP-200-only callback decodes operation state, caches it for details and passes a pager to cls or returns it.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The aio/_patch.py exports the client subclass with an implemented async begin method building a custom poller and result callback around the generated private initial operation.

omissions.subtype: Page operation-state actions through GET next links
omissions.explanation: Nested pager helpers create an ItemPaged starting with the completed operation state, yield one actions container per state and fetch subsequent states with a GET to each next_link, requiring HTTP 200.
omissions.handwrittenRationale: The exported root _patch.py client implements these nested request and pager helpers inside its handwritten begin method rather than only invoking a generated pager.

omissions.subtype: Page async operation-state actions through GET next links
omissions.explanation: Nested async pager helpers create an AsyncItemPaged starting with the completed operation state, yield one actions container per state and fetch subsequent states by GET to each next_link, requiring HTTP 200 and reading the response.
omissions.handwrittenRationale: The exported aio/_patch.py client implements these nested async request and pager helpers within its handwritten begin method rather than only invoking a generated pager.
